I am a woman farmer here in the North West, and on this small plot of 0.29 hectares I am planting beans with other crops mixed in. I have no schooling and not much money, so I cannot buy much fertilizer — beans also fix their own nitrogen, so I will only put a little, and I will spread some manure from my animals to help the soil. I will use my own seed saved from last season like my neighbors do, and I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains. My family and I will do most of the work ourselves, and maybe hire a few hands for weeding when the work is heavy.
